Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can process it. Even if you don't have 3 or fewer security cards, this card's [When Digivolving] effect allows you to have this Digimon attack.
Card Q&A.q: Can I process the part of the effect after "then" in this card's [When Digivolving] effect even if the "if" condition in the 1st process isn't met?

Effect: [When Digivolving] If you have 3 or fewer security cards, this Digimon gains ＜Rush＞ and +3000 DP until your opponent’s turn ends. Then, this Digimon may attack.
Inherited Effect: ＜Decode 《[Aegiomon]》＞ (When this Digimon would leave the battle area other than in battle, you may play 1 [Aegiomon] from its digivolution cards without paying the cost.)
